note: ALOHA-style camera rig per IKEA MuJoCo standard task (scripts/ikea_mujoco/mk_standard_tasks.py writes each task's environment/sim/rig.json from it). center = the middle of the work surface (x, y, its top z), front = the horizontal direction the static cameras look from (unit, world), scale = rig size. cam_high: above the front of the work surface (0.30 scale in front of the centre, 1.0 scale up), looking down at 0.15 scale behind the centre. cam_low: low at the front edge (0.85 scale in front, 0.18 m up), looking at 0.2 scale behind the centre, 0.05 m up. Wrist cameras: Panda: on the hand, 7 cm to the side of the fingers' travel axis, looking at a point 14 cm along the approach axis; ViperX: the arm's own ALOHA wrist camera (model camera). All 848 x 480, vertical field of view 58 degrees.
